references.text: The Israelites also grumbled against Moses and Aaron in the Desert of Sin because of a lack of food, showing a repeated pattern of complaining against leadership.
The people again grumbled against Moses at Rephidim due to a shortage of water, asking why he had brought them out of Egypt.
The Israelites grumbled against Moses and Aaron after the spies returned with a negative report about Canaan.
The congregation had no water and gathered against Moses and Aaron with complaints, a pattern that repeats throughout the wilderness journey.
The people spoke against God and against Moses, complaining about the lack of bread and water in the wilderness.
The psalmist describes how the Israelites grumbled in their tents and did not listen to the Lord's voice.
Paul warns the Corinthians not to grumble as some of the Israelites did and were killed by the destroyer.
